# Giza Plateau tickets — official pricing + booking rules

## Foreign-visitor prices (EGP, per person)

| Ticket | Adult | Student |
|---|---|---|
| Plateau entry (main site) | 700 | 350 |
| + Great Pyramid (Khufu) interior | 1,500 | 750 |
| + Menkaure Pyramid interior | 280 | 140 |
| + Queen Mars Ankh Tomb (Hetepheres) | 200 | 100 |
| + Labor Tombs (Workers') | 700 | 350 |

Egyptian rates for reference: plateau 60/30, Khufu 150/75, Menkaure 30/10, Queen 20/5, Labor 700/350.

## Totals for 3 adults

- Plateau only: 2,100 EGP (~USD 42 / EUR 36 / AED 153)
- Plateau + Khufu interior: 6,600 EGP (~USD 131 / EUR 113 / AED 482)
- FX 2026-08-29: 1 EGP = 0.0199 USD / 0.0171 EUR / 0.0731 AED (open.er-api.com)

## Hours + rules

- Open daily 07:00, last entry 16:00 (summer + winter); Ramadan 08:00-15:30.
- Ticket requires account information (submitted during checkout).
- Egyptians must show valid ID; students must show valid student ID.
- Tickets are non-refundable, cannot be canceled or replaced if lost/stolen — date must be right at purchase.
- Fraud warning: 5x ticket price.

## Payment + support

- Visa and Mastercard (all channels: web, Experience Egypt app, on-site counters, kiosks).
- Support: tourism_info@efinance.com.eg.

## Booking path

egymonuments.com/details/Pyramids → Book Now → /book-date/2 (pick date, ticket types, cart) → checkout (account info) → pay. Max 50 per ticket type per order; multi-site cart supported.

## Availability

- No timed-entry slots for plateau entry; Giza is not a sellout risk on normal days.
- Khufu interior is capacity-capped daily — e-ticket in advance is the safe route if interior access is wanted.

## Next step (open as of filing)

Need visit date + interior preference (asked via RDP-30 on 2026-08-29; answer pending). Then cart goes to the payment step and the user approves and pays (draft-only hard boundary: no purchase by the team).
